Bombay.Stories.2026 DESCRIOTION FOR IT
Bombay Stories (2026) is an Indian anthology drama film that explores the lives of women navigating Mumbai’s red-light district. Directed by Rahhat Shah Kazmi, the movie is deeply inspired by the renowned literary works of the legendary Urdu writer Saadat Hasan Manto. It draws context from several of his provocative short stories, including Hatak, Khusya, and Bu.
Plot & Synopsis
Set against the backdrop of 1930s Bombay, the film interweaves the narratives of sex workers, exploring their relationships, struggles, and survival beneath the surface of the busy city. It tackles intense themes of desire, exploitation, loneliness, and rejection using a mix of drama, tragedy, and erotica. True to Manto's style, the film portrays the darker realities of society and carries the poignant tagline: "If you cannot bear these stories, then society itself is unbearable."
Key Details
• Direct-to-OTT Release: The film premiered directly on the streaming platform JioHotstar on September 28, 2026.
• Cannes Premiere: Prior to its digital release, it made its world premiere at the Marché du Film during the Cannes Film Festival 2026 in May.
• Run Time: 2 hours 11 minutes.
• Main Cast: Mouni Roy, Anupriya Goenka, Monica Aggarwal, Gargi Duggal, and Rrahul Sudhir.

The.Paradise.2026
The Paradise (2026) is an Indian Telugu-language period action drama film directed by Srikanth Odela and starring Nani in the lead role. Set against the gritty, raw backdrop of a slum in 1980s Secunderabad, the epic narrative centers around a highly anticipated mythological motif involving the mysterious goddess Dhumavati—associated with smoke, dust, and destruction.
Plot & Synopsis
The story follows Jadal (played by Nani), an unexpected leader who rises from a brutal world forged by violence and rebellion. He guides the Savari, a heavily marginalized tribe, in a fierce battle against systemic oppression, severe discrimination, and a desperate fight to reclaim their identity and citizenship rights. Characterized by an intense atmosphere of rain, mud, and raw defiance, the film depicts a community metaphorically described as "ravens who have traded their feathers for swords" to challenge the powerful elite.
Key Details
• Theatrical Release: The film made its grand global theatrical debut on September 24, 2026, releasing in multiple formats including 4DX and Dolby Cinema.
• Censor Rating & Runtime: It received an 'A' (Adults Only) certification due to its intense themes and raw action, carrying a runtime of 2 hours 54 minutes.
• Box Office Force: Backed by an electric score from composer Anirudh Ravichander, the movie crossed the monumental ₹100 crore mark in India within its first six days. It has amassed over ₹138 crore worldwide, marking the biggest career opening for Nani despite generating mixed reviews from critics regarding its pacing.
• Star-Studded Cast: Alongside Nani, the film features power-packed performances by Mohan Babu as Shikanja Malik, Raghav Juyal as Vikram Malik, Kayadu Lohar as Subbalakshmi, and Sonali Kulkarni as Samakka.

Awarapan 2 (2026)
Awarapan 2 (2026) is a Hindi-language romantic action crime thriller directed by Nitin Kakkar and produced by Mukesh Bhatt and Vishesh Bhatt under the Vishesh Films banner. The film serves as the long-awaited sequel to the 2007 cult hit Awarapan, bringing Emraan Hashmi back to reprise his iconic role as Shivam Pandit.
Plot & Synopsis
Set nearly two decades after the tragic events of the first film, a grief-stricken Shivam has left his dark past behind. However, his quiet life is upended when a young orphan girl and several other children are captured by a dangerous international human trafficking syndicate operating out of Bangkok. To save them, Shivam is forced to descend back into the criminal underworld, crossing paths with powerful drug lords Nafisa and Amrit. His journey becomes an intense, action-packed path toward redemption, love, and ultimate sacrifice.
Key Details
• Theatrical Release: The film was released worldwide on August 14, 2026, timed perfectly for the Independence Day weekend.
• Box Office Success: Despite receiving mixed reviews from critics who drew heavy comparisons to the original, the movie was a major commercial hit, grossing over ₹207 crore worldwide and solidifying itself as one of the highest-grossing Hindi films of the year.
• Music: Staying true to the franchise's reputation for iconic soundtracks, the movie features an emotional and highly praised musical score composed by Mithoon, Jeet Gannguli, Amaal Mallik, and Akhil Sachdeva.
• Runtime & Certification: The film has a runtime of 2 hours 20 minutes and received a UA 16+ certification.
• Streaming Partner: Following its theatrical run, the film's digital rights were acquired by Prime Video.
Main Cast
• Emraan Hashmi as Shivam Pandit
• Disha Patani as Zara
• Shabana Azmi as Nafisa
• Puran Gabbi as Zorawar
• Shriya Saran as Aliyah (reprising her role in flashbacks)
• Suvinder Vicky as Jaideep

The Vvaan Force of the Forrest (2026)
The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest (2026) is an Indian Hindi-language action adventure fantasy mystery thriller. Co-produced by Balaji Motion Pictures and TVF Motion Pictures, the film is directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra and written by TVF founder Arunabh Kumar. Rooted deeply in Indian folklore, mysticism, and ancient beliefs, the project marks a unique cinematic collaboration between traditional Bollywood drama and digital storytelling pioneers.
Plot & Synopsis
The narrative follows Rishi (played by Sidharth Malhotra), a rational, city-bred urban man living in Mumbai with his wife, Mamta (played by Tamannaah Bhatia). After years of staying away, Rishi returns to his ancestral village of Devanchal for Chhath Puja and to handle a local land acquisition dispute involving a proposed road.
The local villagers are fiercely protective of the adjacent woodland, strictly avoiding it after sunset to avoid angering the 'Van Devi' (a primordial forest goddess). Defying these ancient taboos, Rishi enters the forbidden perimeter. His actions unleash chaotic, illogical supernatural forces, thrusting him into a trial where he must bridge logic with spirituality to become the savior protecting his people from absolute destruction.
Key Details
• Theatrical Release: Following multiple production delays that pushed it out of its original 2025 window, the film was officially released in cinemas worldwide on September 25, 2026.
• Run Time: 2 hours 45 minutes.
• Ensemble Cast: The movie features prominent performances from Sunil Grover, Maniesh Paul, Shweta Tiwari, and Anup Soni (playing Rishi's brother).
• Musical Landscape: To match its epic folklore scale, the film features a massive collaborative soundtrack composed by Vishal Mishra, Amit Trivedi, Tanishk Bagchi, Sam C.S., and a background score by Sandeep Shirodkar.
